column1: # Taken from https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/mario-kart-7 (game rip), trimmed and reordered by hand.
# Kept: one track per course plus its Underwater mix and Rainbow Road (Moon); fanfares; menus, results and credits.
# Dropped: Final Lap, 30 Seconds Left and Underwater Final Lap variants, Download Play tracks, Frontrunning layers.
# Order: intro, then the cups (Mushroom, Flower, Star, Special, Shell, Banana, Leaf, Lightning), then the rest in rip order.
# A track shared by two courses sits in the cup of its first course. "(All Channels)" dropped from menu titles.
